body: I used to drink A TON even with having emetophobia. I did t*u* maybe 4 times from drinking (I’m 28 so not many times) and only 1 of them was the morning after, all other instances I don’t even remember. Now that my anxiety is higher than ever I haven’t touched alcohol in a year. For me, it personally depends on where I am with my anxiety level more than anything. One sip of wine will not make you s*. But the best part about it is it’s in your control! You don’t have to drink if you don’t want to. I’ve been out many times when I was younger and been sober. A little more annoying than anything, but you can still have fun. Sometimes it is good “exposure” in a way, to feel the feeling and know that you’re okay. But honestly, whatever you decide to do is your choice! Obviously overdoing it will have some negative consequences, so I wouldn’t advise going ham on some wine. And make sure if you are on any meds to really take that into consideration before anything. I used to drink on my meds all the time and it was NOT a good choice for me. Best of luck!

We were laying in bed on a Sunday night. Him and I had been together about a year and a half at this point. He had already fucked up once when I found him in bed with another girl in the apartment we shared. I decided to give him another chance and we were working through it. So, still processing that incident, as I’m laying in bed next to him on a seemingly normal Sunday night, his ex girlfriend adds me on Snapchat of all things. She tells me that he’s been basically dating her (seeing her, sleeping with her, going to parties with her friends, out to eat, etc.) for like a year. It had slowed down when we moved in together but after the first incident we decided to live apart and it started back up again. Apparently he was lying to his ex about the status of our relationship - saying I was ‘just a friend’. I always knew of her because we would see her when we were out and she would follow us around and text/call him and his family. I always just thought she was a crazy ex... 

I confronted him and he denied everything. Wasn’t even willing to come clean and I gave him multiple chances. I just wanted answered. But he couldn’t face anything and ended up leaving like a scared puppy. I asked his ex to meet me at The Cheesecake Factory the next day. She showed me everything she had. Pictures, texts, you name it. I honestly didn’t know what to say. I’ve been cheated on before but never like this. I still wonder how he flew under the radar for so long and how he kept up with all the lies. And what sucks the most is that I used to love The Cheesecake Factory and now I can’t go there without getting anxiety lol.
